title: Minimum Number Of Coins To Be Added
statement:
Given positive coin values and `target`, add the fewest coins so every value from `1` through `target` can be formed as a sum of available coins. Return the number of added coins.

## Examples

```text
Input: coins = [1, 4, 10], target = 19
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: coins = [1, 1, 1], target = 20
Output: 3
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= coins.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= coins[i] <= target <= 10^5`
